metaTitle: Custom Heat Transfer Sports Gear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom heat transfer sports gear for teams and events. Durable, full-color designs from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Heat transfer decoration is ideal for sports gear that needs vibrant, full-color logos or detailed artwork without the setup costs of embroidery. Whether you are outfitting a corporate softball team or supplying branded gear for a company-wide wellness challenge, heat transfer delivers crisp graphics that hold up through repeated washing and active use. The process works well on polyester blends, performance fabrics, and cotton, making it a versatile choice for jerseys, hats, and bags. This method also allows for smaller minimum orders compared to screen printing, so it fits both large league orders and smaller departmental teams.
heroAltText: Custom heat transfer sports gear including jerseys and hats with vivid team logos and player numbers
